reason: Basics stay free and it's one payment, no subscription, so I'm not mad. I'm a collector, 24 hats and 8 colours for my pet is exactly what I spend on in Finch, so $4.99 for everything is easy.
objection: I only trust the 'free forever' part if the 7 days are real and nothing I use gets moved behind Plus later. Also the lock screen widget better actually work.
would_change_my_mind: If a basic thing I already use (reminders, repeat tasks) got locked, or if the closet looked small and recycled.
